terms.def: Koivu (Finnish for birch) is a colour in the tiili brand palette, `#D9A43A`, a warm yellow used for warnings. It colours the Dock icon's attention ring and the yellow in the [[tiili-themes|tiili themes]].

A [[koivu]] ring drawn just inside the edge of the macOS Dock icon while a [[pane]] is marked for attention and no [[tiili]] window is in front. It breathes in opacity between 80 % and 35 % over about 3 seconds, or holds at 80 % with reduced motion, and goes when the last mark clears or a window comes to the front.

A [[pane]] is marked for attention when it needs the user, for example an agent in it rings the terminal bell while the user is elsewhere. While any pane is marked, [[tiili]] shows the Dock badge and the [[attention-ring]].
The "Hot cursor" icon frames that the Dock icon cycles while any [[pane]] is working, one set per light or dark variant. The cycle holds frame 0 when the OS asks for reduced motion.

The macOS app icon compiled from the Icon Composer bundle `AppIcon.icon` into `Assets.car`. macOS draws its Liquid Glass rim only on this icon, so [[tiili]] shows it in the Dock when no pane is working and no [[attention-ring]] is up, and swaps in a run-time PNG otherwise.
Rust crates that bind Apple's Objective-C frameworks (`objc2-app-kit`, `objc2-foundation`). The app uses them to swap the Dock icon at run time in `src/app_icon.rs`.

Function in `app_icon.rs` that shows or hides the [[attention-ring]]. It does nothing outside macOS and starts the ticker thread when the ring turns on. [[tiili]]'s attention code calls it whenever the set of marked panes or the front window changes.
Function in `app_icon.rs` that returns the [[attention-ring]]'s opacity at a breathing step: a cosine from `RING_MAX` (0.8) down to `RING_MIN` (0.35) and back over `RING_TICKS` steps.
Function in `app_icon.rs` that gives the [[attention-ring]]'s line width (6 % of the tile side) and corner radius for a tile, so the stroke sits just inside the tile's edge.
Struct in `app_icon.rs` holding what the Dock shows: an `Icon` and the optional [[attention-ring]] breathing step. The last `Shown` is remembered so an unchanged state is not set again on every tick.

Struct in `app_icon.rs` holding the state of the icon ticker thread: whether it is ticking, its current tick, and whether a pane wants attention. It decides whether the ticker has anything to animate.
Constants in `app_icon.rs` for the [[attention-ring]]'s timing: `RING_TICK` is 83 ms per tick while the ring shows, and `RING_TICKS` is 36 ticks, about 3 seconds, per breath.
Constant in `app_icon.rs`, 4, the number of `RING_TICK` ticks per [[working-frames|working frame]], so the working frames keep their pace while the ring ticks faster.
Constant in `app_icon.rs`, 333 ms, the time between [[working-frames|working frames]] of the Dock icon.
Pull request "Breathe a koivu ring round the Dock icon while a pane wants attention": adds the [[attention-ring]] to the macOS Dock icon, with its spec requirement and docs.
Apple's tool for designing app icons as layered bundles with light and dark appearances. Its bundles compile into an asset catalog (`Assets.car`) that macOS uses for the app icon.
Apple's translucent, glass-like design language for macOS and iOS. Its rim effect is drawn on app icons that come from an asset catalog.

The [[harvaaja]] route for work made outside the board: it goes onto a branch, runs the workspace's checks only, and merges automatically once they pass and the base is green. Its PR descriptions say "Fast lane: not reviewed".
